title: Design System: VFL - Valorant Fantasy League

label.purpose: Field labels, kickers, roster row metadata.

micro.purpose: Smallest step - non-interactive crumbs and tabular chip labels only.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting stamped/printed offset for card-like elements.

shadows.name: card-lifted
shadows.purpose: Hover/press step for the same elements - offset grows, never blurs.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The one soft shadow in the system; separates a true overlay (modal/flyout) from the whole page.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The house curve - default for entrances and state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Accent-filled call to action with a notched top-right/bottom-left corner cut.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 9px) 0, 100% 9px, 100% 100%, 9px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 9px)); background: #ff4655; color: #fff; border: none; padding: 15px 24px; font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms, opacity 120ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ff4655; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Nested-slate button that resolves to the accent fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 9px) 0, 100% 9px, 100% 100%, 9px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 9px)); background: #23293a; color: #ece8e1; border: none; padding: 15px 24px; font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ff4655; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff4655; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: 44x44 notched icon tile from the ModeRail; accent fill marks the active route.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav-item ds-nav-item--active" aria-current="page"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M4 4h16v16H4z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #8a8f9e; background: #161b29; border: none; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 8px) 0, 100% 8px, 100% 100%, 8px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 8px)); transition: color 120ms, background 120ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #ece8e1; background: #1e2435; } .ds-nav-item--active, .ds-nav-item--active:hover { color: #fff; background: #ff4655; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Strip
components.description: Sticky page-identity row: mono uppercase crumb (the page's real h1) plus a tabular count.
components.css: .ds-strip { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 0 24px; background: #0b0d14; border-bottom: 1px solid #1c2233; } .ds-strip-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-strip-crumb { margin: 0; color: #8a8f9e; font: 700 13px/1 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-strip-count { color: #ece8e1; font: 700 13px/1 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Data Row Card
components.description: The resting surface for a table/roster row, with a hard-offset printed shadow on its interactive (lifted) state.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #161b29; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4); transition: box-shadow 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-card:hover { background: #1e2435; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transform: translate(-3px, -3px); }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Borderless nested-slate field; the fill itself is the affordance, no outline at rest.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 15px; border: none; background: #23293a; color: #fff; font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff4655; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a8f9e; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Notched Chip
components.description: Specialty/booster chip from PlayerCard: a cut-corner icon tile in the gold sub-brand color, with a flyout tooltip on hover.
components.html: DUELIST BOOST+3 ACS this round
components.css: .ds-chip-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-chip { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 3px solid #d8b34c; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 13px) 0, 100% 13px, 100% 100%, 13px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 13px)); background: #10151d; color: #fff; font: 700 20px/1 'Familjen Grotesk', sans-serif; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.35); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-tip { position: absolute; left: calc(100% + 10px); top: 0; width: 180px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #0c1118; border: 2px solid #fff; color: #fff; font: 600 15px/1.25 'Familjen Grotesk', sans-serif; opacity: 0; transform: translateX(6px); transition: opacity 120ms, transform 120ms; pointer-events: none; } .ds-chip-tip b { display: block; color: #d8b34c; margin-bottom: 3px; } .ds-chip-wrap:hover .ds-chip-tip, .ds-chip:focus-visible + .ds-chip-tip { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

narrative.overview:
VFL reads like the on-screen HUD of a Valorant broadcast, not like a consumer app skinned in red and black: status strips, bracket connectors, and stenciled mono labels sit directly on a near-black ground, and every surface behaves like a data readout rather than a decorative card. The system is deliberately cold and blunt - controls feel like hardware switches, not soft affordances. There is one accent color, and it is spent on the single most important thing on any given screen: the active nav item, the primary CTA, a live score.

The visual grammar is inherited from playvalorant.com and applied globally: sharp corners (mostly true right angles, with a small family of notched/cut corners reserved for interactive chrome), solid flat color fills, uppercase tabular-numeral type, and zero gradients or glows. Separation between regions comes from whitespace and filled surface blocks, never from decorative hairlines - a hairline only appears where it does real structural work (a strip's bottom edge, a table rule).

Depth is cut-and-layered, not lit: elements stack as flat, notched silhouettes on top of one another, and where a shadow does appear it is a hard offset print (5px/5px, zero blur), never a soft ambient glow. Nothing in this system floats on light - it sits, printed, on the surface below it.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (--accent, #ff4655), spent sparingly on active/primary state only
Flat fills over gradients; hard offset shadows over soft blur
Small family of clip-path "cut corner" notches on interactive chrome; everything else is a true right angle
Uppercase mono labels with wide tracking for anything structural (crumbs, counts, nav tips, stat labels)
Tabular numerals wherever a number can change, so digits don't reflow
Density and layout obey a strict 4pt spacing grid and an Apple HIG 44pt/28pt control-size floor

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: --accent marks exactly one thing per screen as primary or active. If two elements both want it, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow blur radius beyond what a hard offset needs, no radial-gradient decoration, no filter: drop-shadow for ambiance. The one intentional exception is the PlayerCard glare layer, which simulates a physical foil card under light - a single, purpose-built effect, not a general pattern.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Structural Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + mono + wide tracking marks structural chrome (crumbs, kickers, nav tips, stat labels). Body copy and player names are never uppercased - that would flatten the one hierarchy signal the mono family provides.

rules.name: The Print-Not-Light Rule
rules.body: A shadow's offset is fixed at 5px/5px (or its 8px/8px lifted step); blur only appears on --shadow-overlay, which is the sole soft-shadow token in the system and exists to separate a full overlay from the page, not to imply directional light on a component.

dos: Do spend --accent on exactly one primary/active element per view (The One Accent Rule).
Do use the notched clip-path cut on interactive chrome only - nav items, buttons, chips, tooltips.
Do set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on any number that can change at runtime.
Do honor the 44px/28px control-size floor (--tap-min / --tap-min-secondary) for every new interactive element.
Do keep body copy and player names in normal case; reserve uppercase for structural/mono labels.
donts: Don't add a soft blurred box-shadow or radial-gradient glow outside the two named exceptions (--shadow-overlay, PlayerCard's glare layer).
Don't round a structural container's corners - true right angles only; the notch cut is reserved for interactive chrome.
Don't introduce a second accent color. Gold and teal are status/sub-brand signals, not alternate accents.
Don't use a decorative hairline; a border only appears where it does real structural work (a strip edge, a table rule, a bracket connector).
